audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 6 read Skill on the full layer while win[3] and win[6] and the packet chart all read Cassiopeia.
audit.why: Content layer and packet agree; the whys on both layers already argue Cassiopeia takes levels 4-5 and the two-item stage.
audit.corrected: phases[3].side and phases[6].side moved to Cassiopeia, with both whys rewritten around Personal Space's 16-to-12 second shield being her only defensive tool. win[N] already matched, so no content-layer chart edit was needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] said Personal Space lets her 'peel from' your stun.
audit.why: Personal Space is a 475-range shield with nearby damage — it grants no cleanse and no displacement.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to say the shield only absorbs the burst, so force it out before committing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content 'early' field attributed the fear to Personal Space. The fear belongs to Doom 'n Gloom, which empowers her NEXT basic ability. The page also never noted that Vex's anti-dash payoff barely applies here.
audit.why: Riot text on P: 'Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark...' Cassiopeia has no dash, so she rarely feeds the mark or the empowered-state cooldown reduction; conversely Miasma's grounding only matters once Shadow Surge exists at 6.
audit.corrected: Fear reattributed to Doom 'n Gloom in early and wants.foe[0], Miasma reframed as a slow before 6 and an anti-Shadow-Surge tool after, and the shield named as the burst gate.

audit.why: It is the field that must carry real numbers.
audit.corrected: Personal Space 16s to 12s, Mistral Bolt 8s to 4s, Looming Darkness flat 12s, Petrifying Gaze 120s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ten misgendered fields calling Vex 'he/his', two verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pastes, and a wave clause about a roaming assassin.
audit.why: lintFindings; Vex is female per champ-gender.js.
audit.corrected: All rewritten with she/her, bullet bodies matched to their titles, worst-wave grounded in her 1200-range Q.

edits.before: - Vex Personal Space (Fear): matchup-defining — Shield + AoE fear that punishes dashes — never dash onto her while her passive glows. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your R Petrifying Gaze like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Personal Space is her only shield: 16s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — force it out, then commit. - Mistral Bolt is 8s at rank 1 down to 4s at rank 5. - Looming Darkness is a flat 12s. - Petrifying Gaze is 120s at rank 1; save it for Shadow Surge landing on you.

edits.before: Ahead, suffocate: poison every last-hit, zone Vex off the wave with fang threat, and call your jungler — your W makes every gank a guaranteed kill.
edits.after: Ahead, deny the shield: poison her before Personal Space is up, hold the 700-range band, and punish every Mistral Bolt she throws at the wave.

edits.before: If Vex takes first blood, tighten up: Personal Space (Fear) is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q-E clears and stay relevant through grounded peel.

edits.before: Your Petrifying Gaze finally gives you a hard lock she can't peel from with Personal Space, letting your all-in land clean if you bait Shadow Surge away first.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze gives you a lock her 475-range Personal Space can only shield against, so force the shield out first and the all-in lands clean.

edits.before: Vex's kit is built to punish immobile poke mages exactly like you — Personal Space fears you if you don't create distance, and Mistral Bolt's slow lets her follow up before you can escape. Play patient through levels 1-2, focus on last-hitting safely, and don't contest extended trades until you have Miasma and Twin Fang both up to answer her aggression.
edits.after: Vex's kit is built to punish immobile poke mages exactly like you — Doom 'n Gloom empowers her next ability to fear you, and Mistral Bolt chips from 1200 range before you can answer it. Play patient through levels 1-2, focus on last-hitting safely, and don't contest extended trades until you have Miasma and Twin Fang both up to answer her aggression.

notes: Vex is female — ten misgendered fields fixed. The fear was attributed to Personal Space in the content 'early' field and in wants.foe[0]; the fear is Doom 'n Gloom (P) empowering her next basic ability, and Personal Space is a 475-range shield. spikes[1] also claimed Personal Space lets her peel out of your stun, which it cannot do. Chart: full-layer rows 3 and 6 said Skill against content-layer and packet Cassiopeia, so I moved the full layer; win[N] needed no edit. Worth knowing and stated where it fits: Cassiopeia has no dash, so she almost never feeds Vex's dash mark or the cooldown reduction on her empowered state, and Miasma's grounding is only relevant from level 6 against the Shadow Surge recast. One field I judged templated but did NOT touch: focus.text reads 'Vex Personal Space (Fear)', which mislabels the shield as the fear — it is 25 characters and sits at the applier's skip threshold, so it needs a hand fix rather than an edit from me. Two packet suspectNames are false positives: 'Your Petrifying Gaze' and "Mistral Bolt's" are both correct names.
